description: Use when an agent needs specific fields from a web page as JSON. Input: url, schema (URL-encoded JSON Schema, object root, max 30 properties, depth 3, 3,000 chars). Output: JSON data validated against the schema (null when not on the page), title, finalUrl. SSRF-safe; noai pages refused; bad schema refused before payment. Fixed schema: /v1/docs/extract. Example: ?url=https://example.com/&schema={"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"}}} Price: $0.006 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

schema.description: JSON Schema (object root) describing the fields to extract

name: web_extract
title: Web extract: any web page into JSON matching your own JSON Schema
